question: Who among the following is the first vocalist to receive the Bharat Ratna in 2009 and is also credited to have popularised 'Khyal Gayaki'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Bhimsen Joshi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pandit Bhimsen Joshi** was the first vocalist to receive the Bharat Ratna in 2009.
 
• He is renowned for his contribution to Hindustani classical music.
 
• He is credited with popularising the **'Khyal Gayaki'** style of singing.
 
• His music is characterized by a powerful voice and intricate improvisations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Ratna**

 
 
• The Bharat Ratna is India's highest civilian award, given for exceptional service towards the advancement of Art, Literature, and Science, and in recognition of public service of the highest order.
 
• It was instituted in 1954 and the recipients receive a certificate known as 'Sanad' signed by the President of India and a medallion.
 
• The recommendations for the Bharat Ratna are made by the Prime Minister of India to the President, with a maximum of three nominees being awarded each year.
 
 
 
• **Khyal Gayaki**
 
 
• 'Khyal' is a form of vocal music in Hindustani classical music.
 
• It is characterized by a greater emphasis on improvisation and flexibility.
 
• This style of singing allows the artist to explore the raga extensively, often with intricate and complex patterns.
 
• The word 'Khyal' means imagination, thought, or idea, reflecting the creative freedom this style offers to the performer.
 
 
 
• **Pandit Bhimsen Joshi**
 
 
• Pandit Bhimsen Joshi was born on February 4, 1922, in Gadag, Karnataka.
 
• He belonged to the Kirana gharana and was a disciple of Sawai Gandharva.
 
• He was known for his deep, robust voice and mastery over ragas such as Puriya Dhanashree, Multani, and Miyan Ki Todi.
 
• In addition to Bharat Ratna, he was also awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, Padma Shree, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan.
